summary: Canadian Solar Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing that its Spanish subsidiary registered a EUR 50 million Green Medium Term Note Program on Spain's MARF, a multilateral trading facility for debt securities. The parent company guarantees up to EUR 65 million with a duration limitation. Notes may be green bonds under ICMA principles and Sustainalytics provided a second-party opinion. Proceeds will fund solar and battery storage projects in EMEA and OECD countries, plus general corporate purposes. Notes are offered only to non-U.S. persons via Regulation S and qualified investors in the EU. This is a routine debt program establishment, not a special situation.
